overlap.head: 7f86285384b5161a5fd6051e44ac6f4f1ed5929a
overlap.scope: privacy-safe JSON-RPC traffic recording/redaction and response replay; not ledger-state-backed local Soroban host execution

findings: PR #114 should be reused for privacy/redaction/response-replay primitives but does not satisfy ledger-state-backed offline execution
current src/utils/soroban.rs contains explicit mock/placeholder XDR paths and must not become snapshot truth
query executor already demonstrates canonical stellar-xdr LedgerKey encoding and an injectable RpcTransport boundary
release subsystem provides deterministic archive/checksum/versioned migration patterns but its fixed 0755 archive entry mode is not the snapshot security contract
signer-rotation/query output code already provides 0600/0700 private atomic persistence conventions

Cargo.toml has stellar-xdr and wasmi but no Soroban host implementation dependency; a compatible host/runtime dependency or equivalent real host integration is required for offline simulation semantics
